limitations: Ensemble spread and percentiles describe the returned members; they are not a probability, confidence, risk or skill measure.
Modelled grid values are not local measurements.
Run identity is not exposed; retrieval time is not model issue time.
A member exceedance count is a frequency over members, which are not independent draws.

statistics.mean: arithmetic mean of the returned perturbed members
statistics.spread: population standard deviation across the returned members
statistics.percentile: nearest-rank on the sorted member values
